summary.text: Michael Conway is the Republican candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 14A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Abdi Daisane after advancing from the August 11 Republican primary.
A software trainer from St. Cloud, he previously worked as an educator with Saint Paul Public Schools.

paragraphs.text: Michael Conway lives in St. Cloud and, according to Ballotpedia, worked as an educator with Saint Paul Public Schools before becoming a software trainer for Wolters Kluwer Financial Services.
He ran for an at-large seat on the St. Cloud school board in 2014, finishing fifth in a field of six candidates for three seats.
